[6] Nothing can break the tie
Every rule declines. The audit blocks rather than picking.
conflict: p-x vs p-y — exclusive: disabled vs enabled
resolution: UNRESOLVED — every rule declined (authority, recency, corroboration)
decision: BLOCKED — do not generate on [caching-prompt]
[8] A negation a similarity score would miss
Every content word matches. The one token that reverses the sentence does not.
conflict: p-off vs p-on — polarity: one side is negated over 5 shared terms
resolution: RESOLVED by recency → [p-off]
[11] One dispute, two ladders
The order of the rules is the policy, and it changes the answer.
ladder [authority]: RESOLVED by authority → [p-spec]
ladder [corroboration]: RESOLVED by corroboration → [p-a, p-b]
[12] What the auditor refuses
empty retrieved set: no passages to audit
two passages sharing an id: passage id 'p-1' appears more than once
a topic that normalizes to nothing: topic 'the of and' normalizes to nothing
a repeated ladder rule: resolution rule 'authority' appears more than once
